CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steve Talt, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108
Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 29, 2023 AT 9:30 AM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with  valuable  information  regarding  issues  of  the  community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned  meetings are held  on  the last  Friday of every month  at  8:30  a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626)
300-0705  prior  to  the  meeting  for  assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do  it’s  best  to  resolve  any  technical  issues  as  quickly  as  possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85638871973
  Meeting ID: 856 3887 1973
  Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 856 3887 1973

 How to offer public comment from home:
  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time, and previously
  distributed public comment will be noted. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will
  be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.

  Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place
limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  CEREMONIAL

 PROCLAMATION DENOUNCING ANTISEMITISM AND ALL FORMS OF HATE

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 29, 2023  PAGE 2 of 4
 1.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-23-
  1406 (FIRST READING) ADDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 23.06.16
  TO IMPLEMENT STATE LAW REGARDING PARKING REQUIREMENTS
  WITHIN  A  HALF-MILE  OF  PUBLIC  TRANSIT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council conduct a public hearing and
  introduce for first reading Ordinance No. O-23-1406. If the City Council agrees, an
  appropriate  motion  would  be:

  “I move to waive full reading and introduce by title only Ordinance No. O-23-1406, an
  Ordinance of the San Marino City Council adding San Marino Municipal Code Section
  23.06.16 to implement Assembly Bill 2097 by eliminating minimum parking
  requirements on a residential, commercial, or other development project if the project
  is located within one-half mile of public transit.”

2.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-23-
  1407 (FIRST READING) AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS
  23.02.14 AND 23.15.04.1 TO ALLOW MINISTERIAL APPROVAL WHEN
  RECONFIGURING SPACE WITHIN AN EXISTING DWELLING UNIT IN
  THE SINGLE-FAMILY (R-1) ZONE TO CREATE NO MORE THAN TWO
  ADDITIONAL  BEDROOMS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council conduct a public hearing and
  introduce for first reading Ordinance No. O-23-1407. If the City Council agrees, an
  appropriate  motion  would  be:

  “I move to waive full reading and introduce by title only Ordinance No. O-23- 1407, an
  Ordinance of the San Marino City Council amending San Marino Municipal Code
  Sections 23.02.14 and 23.15.04.01 to implement Assembly Bill 916 by allowing
  ministerial approval when reconfiguring space within an existing residential dwelling
  unit in the single-family (R-1) zone to create no more than two additional bedrooms.”

  NEW BUSINESS

3.  AMERICAN  RESCUE  PLAN  ACT  APPROPRIATIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the budget appropriations
  as noted in the staff report to appropriate funds from the American Rescue Plan Fund
  for costs that the City has already incurred or for projects that are on-going. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the budget appropriations as noted in the staff report to

   appropriate funds from the American Rescue Plan Fund for costs that the City has
  already incurred or for projects that are on-going.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 4.  APPROVAL OF OFFICE OF TRAFFIC SAFETY (OTS) GRANT AGREEMENT
  FOR  SELECTIVE  TRAFFIC  ENFORCEMENT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends City Council approve the agreements for OTS
  Grant Funding and authorize the Chief of Police and the Finance Director to enter into
  the agreements with the Office of Traffic Safety in an amount not to exceed $83,040
  in the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024 and add $83,040 of estimated revenues and
  appropriate $83,040 of expenditures as noted in the Staff Report from the OTS Grant
  Fund. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion
  would  be:

  “I move to approve and authorize the Chief of Police and the Finance Director to enter
  into the agreements with the Office of Traffic Safety in an amount not to exceed
  $83,040 in the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024, and add $83,040 of estimated
  revenues and appropriate $83,040 of expenditures as noted in the Staff Report from
  the OTS Grant Fund.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
